note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: [F] proves, rather than cites, the part of Silverman VII.2.1 that [M] uses: for y^2 = x^3 + Ax over the localization of Z[s] at a prime pi not dividing 2, reduction is a homomorphism from W0(pi) to the nonsingular reduced points with kernel W1(pi), so the reduced point's order sends Q into W1(pi). It is specialized to these curves and global localizations and omits the surjectivity in Silverman's exact sequence, which [M] does not use; the standing is proved without hypotheses.
